module: Small GE-side utility for the layout of the Vue options menu. It reads which layout.json / layout.dev.json files exist in the user folder and can save a layout in /ui/ui-vue/src/modules/options/runtime/ (therefore in the user folder). Useful to a modder who wants to override the options menu structure.
notes: The saveLayout key must be empty/nil or match ^[%w%-_]+$; otherwise the function logs an error and returns false.
isValidKey is only called if key is neither nil nor empty, so there is no risk of a string.match error on nil.

getUserFolderLayouts.desc: Lists those of the layout.json and layout.dev.json files whose real path is under the user folder (FS:getUserPath).

returns.desc: File names found; empty if the user folder is unknown.

saveLayout.desc: Writes the JSON data to layout[.key].json under /ui/ui-vue/src/modules/options/runtime/ via writeFile.

key.desc: File suffix (safe slug); nil or empty for layout.json.

returns.desc: true if the write succeeded, false if data is not a string, the key is invalid or the write fails.
